Theorem
[Infinite differentiability] ↗ thm:hyperbolic-higher-regularity 1. ch7:7.2-thm-7\group Regularity

Assume \[ g, h \in C^\infty (\bar{U}), \quad f \in C^\infty (\bar{U}_T), \] and the $m^{\text{th}}$-order compatibility conditions hold for $m = 0, 1, \ldots $.

Then the hyperbolic initial/boundary-value problem (1) has a unique solution \[ u \in C^\infty (\bar{U}_T). \]

Proof

\sketch Higher hyperbolic regularity gives Sobolev estimates of arbitrary order; Sobolev embedding in space and time yields smoothness.

□
